spec.title: vscode PROP-002: Tree layout - the own root, own extensions, cleanup, forbidden targets

status.comment: the type's answer to the layout question of PROP-016 §2; the anchored facts moved verbatim from modules/codkit/PROP-005 in the split of 2026-09-09

p.OWN-UNDER-SRC-VS: The directory is placed under `src/vs/<ownDirName>/`; on every new pin the cycle checks that the actual tsconfig, layering, test and nls globs of the selected fork cover that path.

p.VSCODE-OWN-ROOT-CONSTRAINT: The type's constraint on `typeConfig.ownRoot` is that the own root lies under `src/vs/` (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-016#TYPE-OWN-ROOT`); a root outside it is `CK-E-CONFIG` naming the constraint. The field is required and has no default - schema 2 is the only schema (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-016#TYPE-SCHEMA-2-REQUIRED`). The engine treats the root as an opaque directory - mirrored by content, excluded from the drift guard, named in the inventory - and only this type knows why it has to sit under `src/vs/`: the tsconfig, layering, test and nls globs of the distribution are anchored there.

p.OWN-EXTENSION-UNIT: The `own-extension` kind of unit: the directory `delta/own-extensions/<name>/**` is mirrored into `<tree>/extensions/<name>/**` (the rsync semantics of `OWN-SOURCE-OF-TRUTH`: `load` into the tree, `save` back, `ci` into the own commit of the generated branch). The declaration is the section `extensions: [{ id, name, owner, reason, pin, contractTests }]` of the `patchset.delta.json` manifest (schema `codkitOwnManifest: 2`, an absent section is admissible); `name` has the form `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` and is unique; the directory must contain the `package.json` of the extension; a directory under `delta/own-extensions/` that is declared by no entry is a violation as well (otherwise it silently fails to materialize, the analogue of `OWN-UNCOVERED`); a violation is `CK-E-OWN-EXTENSION-MANIFEST`; an extension named after an existing upstream directory `extensions/<name>` on the pin is the same refusal with the text `name collides with an upstream extension`. Drift between the tree and the delta is `CK-E-OWN-EXTENSION-DRIFT` in `verify`. In the inventory it is an entry with layer `own` and category `own-extension`. An empty section is serialized as absent (the canonical bytes of the manifest do not change). The managed block of `info/exclude` (`OWN-EXCLUDED-LOCALLY`) does not cover extensions: `git status` shows `extensions/<name>/` as untracked, and the dirt guards filter it by prefix; extending the block to extensions is a separate rule (deferred).

p.OWN-EXTENSION-STRANDED: Removing the declaration does not remove the materialization: `load` mirrors only the declared extensions, while the directory `<tree>/extensions/<name>/` of a removed extension stays in the tree untracked - it is removed by `load --fresh` (the cleanup of untracked paths, PROP-011 §4), and no other command deletes it (an untracked directory under `extensions/` may equally be a person's local experiment); a plain `load` over such a tree passes and does not touch the directory - the drift guard does not count a stranded materialization as dirt (PROP-008 `DRIFT-GUARD-PREDICATE`, the exception of 2026-09-08: `load` neither writes into that directory nor deletes it, so a refusal would guard nothing), and for the other commands nothing changes: `cycle start` refuses with `CK-E-DIRTY-TREE`, `sync` with `CK-E-NEW-FILE-IN-UPSTREAM-ZONE`, and `ci` and `publish` remove the untracked paths with a fresh pass. So that this is not silent, `status` names such directories stranded materializations (PROP-007 `CMD-STATUS`): an untracked directory under `extensions/` that is covered by no declaration and does not exist on the pin. Observed by the product campaign of 2026-09-08.

p.OWN-EXTENSION-WHY: Why the layer: a language pack for the strings of own code (`contributes.localizations`), themes and a product icon theme, a walkthrough, `configurationDefaults` - all of this is the Extension API, the most sanctioned seam after `product.json`; without the layer such files would go one by one as add-file patches (`NEW-FILES-LIVE-IN-OWN`). An upstream build fact: a declarative extension is picked up by the glob `extensions/*/package.json` without build edits; an extension with TypeScript requires two entries in the build lists (`build/gulpfile.extensions.ts`, `build/npm/dirs.ts`) - those are two artifacts of the constant graft set (`CONSTANT-GRAFT-SET`), not part of the layer.

lint.title: 3. The lint target of the own directory

p.OWN-LINT-TARGET: An upstream fact: a file without a target in `local/code-import-patterns` gets the warning "Missing definition…", and warnings mean failure; a new directory requires a target in `eslint.config.js` (one block) or an entry in `.eslint-ignore`. The rule: **one patch `CK-build-003`** adds a marked target block for `src/vs/patchset/**` to `eslint.config.js` (next to the entry-module blocks, `eslint.config.js:1975+`).

cleanup.title: 4. The cleanup whitelist and the forbidden patch targets

p.VSCODE-CLEANUP-WHITELIST: The build outputs the fresh pass may remove without asking, that is the value of `cleanupWhitelist` for this type: `node_modules/` at any level, `.build/`, the anchored `/out*/`, `extensions/*/out/`, `extensions/*/dist/`, `.eslintcache`, `*.tsbuildinfo`. The pattern semantics, the algorithm that computes the untracked set and the discipline "what is not in the list is deleted" are the engine's (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-011#CLEANUP-WHITELIST-CONTENT`); which paths a build of this distribution actually leaves behind is the type's answer, and a second type names its own.

p.VSCODE-FORBIDDEN-PATCH-TARGETS: The forbidden patch targets of this type, that is the value of `forbiddenPatchTargets`: `.config/1espt/**` (a file with mixed line endings that no deterministic patch can carry) together with the overlay targets of PROP-003. The field itself, its additive extension through `conventionsExtensionFile` and the refusal `CK-E-FORBIDDEN-TARGET` are the engine's (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-003#CONV-FORBIDDEN-TARGETS`).
